result.topic_en: An expression for s4 involving the radical of 1+20s^4-26s^8-20s^12-s^16 (lemniscatic multiplication), followed by successive derivatives of x with respect to y when dx/dy = X, with coefficient patterns for the higher derivatives and a recursive scheme.

methods.what: Decomposition of the fourth derivative into derivatives of powers of X
